name: HC24: No. active on ART who are Malnourished at the last visit during the reporting quarter
description: Active ART clients classified as malnourished during the reporting quarter. Includes underweight, moderate acute malnutrition, and severe acute malnutrition. Counts unique active ART patients whose last ART visit during the reporting quarter documented moderate acute malnutrition, severe acute malnutrition, or severe acute malnutrition with oedema.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE
    /* Active on ART */
    (
        (a.encounter_date >= :startDate
         AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
        OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
    )

    /* HIV patient */
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
        WHERE s.patient_id = a.patient_id
    )

    /* Has started ART */
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
        WHERE r.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL
          AND r.art_start_date <= :endDate
    )

    /* Last visit in the reporting quarter */
    AND a.encounter_date >= :startDate
    AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
        WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND x.encounter_date > a.encounter_date
          AND x.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    )

    /* Malnutrition documented */
    AND a.nutrition_assesment IN (
        'SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION',
        'SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION WITH OEDEMA',
        'MODERATE ACUTE MALNUTRITION'
    );
